info.name: Movie Watchlist API
info.description:
# Movie Watchlist API

A RESTful API for managing a personal movie watchlist. This API allows users to register and authenticate, browse and manage movies, and maintain a personal watchlist with watch status, ratings, and notes.

## Base URL

All endpoints use the `{{BaseURL}}` variable. Make sure to set this in your active environment before sending requests.

## Authentication

Most endpoints require a valid JWT. After logging in, the token is automatically managed via vault variables. Ensure you are logged in before accessing protected routes.

## Folders

- **Auth** — User registration, login, and logout
    
- **Movies** — Browse, create, update, and delete movies
    
- **Watchlist** — Manage your personal watchlist entries

item.name: Auth

request.description:
Create a new user account.

**Request Body (JSON):**
| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| name | string | Yes | The user's display name |
| email | string | Yes | A unique email address |
| password | string | Yes | Account password |

**Example Request Body:**
```json
{
  "name": "Qasem",
  "email": "qasem@gmail.com",
  "password": "qasem1234"
}
```

**Responses:**
- `201 Created` — Account created successfully
- `400 Bad Request` — Validation error or email already in use

Authenticate a user and start a session.

**Request Body (JSON):**
| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| email | string | Yes | Registered email address |
| password | string | Yes | Account password |

**Example Request Body:**
```json
{
  "email": "basir@gmail.com",
  "password": "basir1234"
}
```

**Responses:**
- `200 OK` — Login successful, returns a JWT token
- `401 Unauthorized` — Invalid credentials

Invalidate the current user session.

No request body is required. The session token is read from the Authorization header or cookie.

**Responses:**
- `200 OK` — Logged out successfully
- `401 Unauthorized` — No active session found

item.description:
## Auth

Handles user authentication and session management.

- **Register** — Create a new user account with a name, email, and password.
- **Login** — Authenticate with email and password to receive a JWT session token.
- **Logout** — Invalidate the current session token.

> All subsequent requests to protected endpoints require a valid session established via Login.

item.name: movies

request.description:
Retrieve a list of all movies in the catalog.

**Query Parameters:**
| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| search | string | No | Filter movies by title keyword |

**Example:** `GET {{BaseURL}}/movies?search=GOT`

**Responses:**
- `200 OK` — Returns an array of movie objects

Retrieve details of a single movie by its UUID.

**Path Parameter:**
| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| id | UUID | Yes | The unique identifier of the movie |

**Example:** `GET {{BaseURL}}/movies/dd8901ab-bde4-477f-a07d-ffd1f8ef5236`

**Responses:**
- `200 OK` — Returns the movie object
- `404 Not Found` — Movie with the given ID does not exist

Partially update an existing movie's details. Requires authentication.

**Path Parameter:**
| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| id | UUID | Yes | The unique identifier of the movie to update |

**Request Body (JSON) — all fields optional:**
| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| title | string | Updated movie title |
| overview | string | Updated synopsis |
| releaseYear | number | Updated release year |
| runtime | number | Updated runtime in seconds |
| posterUrl | string | Updated poster URL |
| genres | string[] | Updated genre list |

**Responses:**
- `200 OK` — Movie updated successfully
- `404 Not Found` — Movie not found
- `401 Unauthorized` — Authentication required

Add a new movie to the catalog. Requires authentication.

**Request Body (JSON):**
| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| title | string | Yes | Movie title |
| overview | string | Yes | Short description or synopsis |
| releaseYear | number | Yes | Year the movie was released |
| runtime | number | Yes | Runtime in seconds |
| posterUrl | string | No | URL to the movie poster image |
| genres | string[] | No | List of genre labels (e.g. "Drama", "Action") |

**Example Request Body:**
```json
{
  "title": "GOT SO3",
  "overview": "Game of thrones war of 7 kingdom.",
  "releaseYear": 2014,
  "runtime": 15400,
  "posterUrl": "https://got.jpg",
  "genres": ["Drama"]
}
```

**Responses:**
- `201 Created` — Movie created successfully
- `400 Bad Request` — Validation error
- `401 Unauthorized` — Authentication required

Remove a movie from the catalog. Requires authentication.

**Path Parameter:**
| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| id | UUID | Yes | The unique identifier of the movie to delete |

**Example:** `DELETE {{BaseURL}}/movies/88e8a272-d8fd-4a6b-b806-cd7e03dd7979`

**Responses:**
- `200 OK` — Movie deleted successfully
- `404 Not Found` — Movie not found
- `401 Unauthorized` — Authentication required

item.description:
## Movies

Endpoints for browsing and managing the movie catalog.

- **Get All Movies** — Retrieve a paginated list of movies. Supports a `search` query parameter to filter by title.
- **Get Movie** — Fetch details of a single movie by its UUID.
- **Create Movie** — Add a new movie to the catalog (title, overview, release year, runtime, poster URL, genres).
- **Update Movie** — Partially update an existing movie's details by its UUID.
- **Delete Movie** — Remove a movie from the catalog by its UUID.

> Requires authentication for write operations (Create, Update, Delete).

item.name: Watchlist

request.description:
Add a movie to the authenticated user's watchlist. Requires authentication.

**Request Body (JSON):**
| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| movieId | UUID | Yes | The ID of the movie to add |
| status | string | Yes | Watch status: `PLANNED`, `WATCHING`, or `COMPLETED` |
| rating | number | No | User rating (e.g. 1–10) |
| notes | string | No | Personal notes about the movie |

**Example Request Body:**
```json
{
  "movieId": "f957c964-551f-417e-9804-d62815542e51",
  "status": "PLANNED",
  "rating": 8,
  "notes": "2000 best movie of the year."
}
```

**Responses:**
- `201 Created` — Watchlist item added
- `400 Bad Request` — Validation error or movie already in watchlist
- `401 Unauthorized` — Authentication required

Remove an entry from the authenticated user's watchlist. Requires authentication.

**Path Parameter:**
| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| id | UUID | Yes | The unique identifier of the watchlist entry to remove |

**Example:** `DELETE {{BaseURL}}/watchlist/b0724bfd-30e5-420d-a519-97f2931a6a41`

**Responses:**
- `200 OK` — Watchlist item removed
- `404 Not Found` — Entry not found
- `401 Unauthorized` — Authentication required

Retrieve all watchlist entries for the currently authenticated user. Requires authentication.

**Responses:**
- `200 OK` — Returns an array of watchlist entries, each containing movie details, status, rating, and notes
- `401 Unauthorized` — Authentication required

Update an existing watchlist entry. Requires authentication.

**Path Parameter:**
| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| id | UUID | Yes | The unique identifier of the watchlist entry |

**Request Body (JSON) — all fields optional:**
| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| status | string | Updated watch status: `PLANNED`, `WATCHING`, or `COMPLETED` |
| rating | number | Updated rating |
| notes | string | Updated personal notes |

**Example Request Body:**
```json
{
  "status": "COMPLETED",
  "rating": 9,
  "notes": "edit by basir"
}
```

**Responses:**
- `200 OK` — Watchlist item updated
- `404 Not Found` — Entry not found
- `401 Unauthorized` — Authentication required

item.description:
## Watchlist

Manage the authenticated user's personal movie watchlist.

- **Add Watchlist Item** — Add a movie to your watchlist with an initial status (`PLANNED`, `WATCHING`, `COMPLETED`), optional rating, and notes.
- **Get Watchlist Item** — Retrieve all watchlist entries for the current user.
- **Update Watchlist Item** — Update the status, rating, or notes of an existing watchlist entry by its UUID.
- **Remove Watchlist Item** — Delete a watchlist entry by its UUID.

> All watchlist endpoints require authentication.

**Responses:**
